title: Valid GitHub Actions context for Production generated-artifact evidence

phases.objective: Replace an unavailable runner context in jobs.refresh.env so GitHub Actions can register and schedule exact-head generated-artifact evidence for pull requests targeting Production.

e2e_journeys.actor: GitHub Actions workflow parser and protected-release reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request targets Production and the protected-promotion evidence workflow is evaluated
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub can plan the workflow, both canonical report paths resolve through github.workspace, and the existing exact-head read-only producer contract remains unchanged.
steps: Detect that runner.temp is unavailable in jobs.refresh.env before a runner exists.
Replace both report paths with github.workspace-backed absolute workspace paths.
Keep JSON and Markdown evidence in one stable .ci-evidence directory across steps with and without working-directory overrides.
Retain same-repository source validation, Production base validation, exact-head checkout, and remote/local SHA equality.
Retain the canonical publisher regression, mutation-boundary regression, generated-artifact evaluator, run-bound Artifact upload, and report enforcement.
Reject future jobs-level runner.temp use through a focused repository test.
assertions: jobs.refresh.env contains no runner context reference.
REPORT_PATH and REPORT_MARKDOWN_PATH use the jobs-level-compatible github.workspace context.
Both paths share the same stable workspace evidence directory.
The workflow name, pull_request events, Production branch filter, Artifact identity, and canonical report contract remain unchanged.
The workflow retains contents:read only and persist-credentials:false.
No workflow dispatch, repository write, force push, migration, SQL/database mutation, deployment, provider call, credential access, or external send occurs.

phases.objective: Observe a real Protected Promotion Generated Artifact Refresh run and trusted canonical publication on an exact pinned Production candidate.
Reject malformed paths, missing reports, stale heads, cross-repository heads, cancelled superseded runs, and future unavailable-context regressions without repository mutation.
Record the first authoritative generated-artifact evidence section on a controlled main-to-Production promotion candidate.
This registration repair grants no deployment, provider, database, migration, credential, or Production mutation authority.
